discovery_confirm.title: Augora found
discovery_confirm.description: Augora was found at {url}. Create an API token under Account in the Augora UI.

user.title: Augora
user.description: Create an API token under Account in the Augora UI.

reauth_confirm.title: Augora
reauth_confirm.description: The API token was rejected. Create a new one under Account in the Augora UI.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach Augora at this url.

abort.already_configured: This Augora server is already configured.

announce.name: Announce
announce.description: Plays an announcement (such as text-to-speech) on speakers or groups and then continues the music. Returns when the announcement has ended.

media_id.name: Media
media_id.description: A media source (such as a text-to-speech message) or the url of an audio file.

volume_level.name: Volume
volume_level.description: Fixed volume for the announcement. The speaker returns to its own volume afterwards. Leave empty to keep the current volume.

resume.name: Resume
resume.description: Continue what was playing, from where it was interrupted, after the announcement.
